reason: The negative estimate (-1.95) depends entirely on controlling for collab_index_2023, a 2023 post-treatment variable that remote_share strongly affects (coef 0.68, p<0.001), so it is a mediator/collider; without it the effect is positive (+0.67, SE 0.22, p=0.003), and the report's single-specification 'negative effect' conclusion is not supported.
